messages:
ashwin: quick q — we're kicking off a short eval with ClearLedger (their usage-based billing). procurement asked for a few clarifications on trial data retention + pricing model. anyone dealt with them before?
maria: not directly. what exactly do we need clarified? retention windows, export, and the SLA for trial usage are the big ones. also whether trial data counts toward billing if we move to paid.
ashwin: pasted the vendor email earlier, but it's a bit vague:
```
Trial stores ingested data for the duration of the trial. After the trial ends, data is retained for an additional 30 days to allow exports and then purged unless a paid contract is signed.
```
that's the whole clause — sounds like 30d but doesn't say whether logs / audit trails are kept or whether exports are available via API.
sam: i'd ask for: (1) explicit export formats (CSV/NDJSON), (2) an API for bulk export, (3) confirmation that logs/audit records are also purgeable on request, and (4) whether trial traffic shows up as billable usage if we flip to paid mid-trial.
procurement-bot: checklist generated: • Data retention window (trial + post-trial) • Export mechanisms (API, manual) • Export formats • Purge process SLA • Billing treatment of trial usage • Security certifications (SOC2, ISO) • Contractual SLA for production post-trial • Any onboarding / overage fees
elaine: also add SSO/SCIM & RBAC questions. If they provision org-level accounts for the trial, we need to know admin controls and ability to offboard users without leaving data behind.
maria: draft email I'm proposing to send to ClearLedger support/legal: 
---
Subject: Clarification on trial data retention, export, and billing treatment
Hi — thanks for onboarding us for the trial. A few clarifying asks so we can complete our internal procurement checklist: 1) Please confirm the exact data retention policy during the trial and the post-trial retention period. 2) Can we export all ingested data (including logs and audit events)? If so, please confirm supported formats and whether a bulk export API is available. 3) If we convert to a paid plan mid-trial, will trial traffic be applied to billing or is a separate billing period used? 4) What controls exist to initiate immediate purge of trial data upon request? 5) Please confirm security/compliance docs (SOC2, data processing addendum) and SSO/SCIM support. 6) Any evaluation discounts or short-term commercial terms you offer for pilots?
Thanks,
Maria (Procurement)
---
please review — i'll send once we have signoff from legal.
ashwin: looks good. can you CC legal@redwood and elaine? also ask them to include an endpoint for export if available (we prefer NDJSON).
maria: will do. elaine — i'll loop you in. sending after 11:00 PT so legal has a window. :+1:
elaine: perfect. maybe request a one-week extension on the trial if export requires coordination.
ashwin: good call. thx all.
